plan.funding: 500 tokens per isolated experiment; original seven-day-agent account is unchanged
plan.interpretation_1_to_1: spot fully funded, no borrowing or margin; options premiums fully funded but economic exposure can exceed 1x

lanes.name: Forward spot tests
requirements: frozen per-arm policies and no retroactive fills
lanes.execution_policy: Separate 500-token accounts per instrument and policy; actual fresh quotes only. Buy/hold budgets 125 or 500 tokens. Experimental momentum uses 5/20 distinct provider-quote observations and +/-5% close-observed thresholds; not the validated daily baseline.

lanes.name: Forward quoted long calls/puts
requirements: verified bid/ask option chain, timestamp, strike, expiry, multiplier, exercise style
whole contracts only; premium and costs within 500 tokens
lanes.implementation_status: blocked: live option-chain connector is not configured; no quoted option fills are implemented

lanes.name: Historical theoretical options sensitivity
requirements: trailing realized volatility is a model input, not observed IV
listed strikes and expiries are not verified

checkpoints.focus: Freeze protocol, validate accounting and run historical options calibration
Record spot and option feed availability and collect any valid forward observations
Review decision timestamps, next-quote execution and prediction horizons
Review long-call/put time decay and volatility sensitivities
Review fees, spreads, slippage and matched-budget benchmark differences
Audit stale prices, rejected orders and cash/position conservation
Check sample coverage and decision logs; freeze report inputs
Publish final verified results, missing-data coverage and lessons

metrics: decision-time information cutoff and fill latency
plan.report_policy: post combined results after study ends; intermediate checkpoints are persisted silently; do not manufacture unavailable live fills

precommitted_exits.note: SPY close before the known Friday Oct 30 regular-session end, because the study ends Sunday. No synthetic close if quotes are absent.

latest_daily_checks.focus: Freeze protocol, validate accounting and run historical options calibration
latest_daily_checks.note: This checkpoint also invokes the eligible spot manager; submitted orders and fills are recorded separately in the ledger. It submits no quoted-option orders. Archived or theoretical results do not count as forward trades.

assumptions: 500 tokens per isolated scenario; whole contracts and fully paid premiums
Hypothetical stock-option multiplier 100; strikes/expiries not verified as listed
14 days to hypothetical expiry at next-observation entry; mark to model during seven calendar days
European Black-Scholes, zero dividend yield, 4% rate; not an American exercise model
Trailing 30-observation realized annual volatility is used as model input, NOT historical implied volatility
Model exit volatility shock -10/0/+10 percentage points, interpolated over the window
3% adverse premium adjustment per side and $0.65 per contract per side; not historical spreads or an actual fee schedule
Long options have intrinsic economic leverage despite fully paid premiums; delta notional is recorded
No live market observations, historical option quotes or options execution results are claimed

quoted_options_execution: not implemented; no actual option-chain connector or quoted fills
